name: rhazi3l-mods
description: Rhazi3l's Claude Code mods, each installed on its own.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: An Info button under the prompt (the toolbox) for the model, effort, advisor and your other mods.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: A plain-English checklist of Claude's plan and progress above the prompt, in place of the technical tool rows.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: A Better button beside Info (or /better) turns a rough prompt into a clearer one. A pane shows both, and nothing is sent until you press Run it.

plugins.name: deskbar
plugins.description: A band above the prompt in the desktop app with the model, effort, context, prompt cache and 5h and weekly usage, like the terminal status line.
